messages:
carmen: Quick sync thread for ODIN-11B int4 bring-up. Ran week-long slice pass; handing off numbers + rollout suggestion for product/GTN.

lee: awesome — short summary first?

carmen: TL;DR: ODIN-11B int4 is promising on unit econ (≈48% token-cost reduction vs 13B-fp16) with small regression on RAG QA F1 (~2.1 pts). Embedding quality for semantic search is effectively unchanged on our customer slice. Latency p95 improves for warmed contexts but cold-start KV tail worsens ~70ms.

ash: paste the bench table pls

carmen: snippet from the canonical pilot slice (avg req = RAG w/ 350 token context):
```
baseline-13b-fp16: cost/req $0.0132, p50 112ms, p95 420ms, RAG-F1 78.4%, Embed-cos 0.872
odin-11b-int4:   cost/req $0.0069, p50 105ms, p95 490ms, RAG-F1 76.3%, Embed-cos 0.868
```
Notes: cost includes doc-lookup rerank + model decode; cache hit-rate = 18% for this slice.

mike: embedding delta tiny — that's good for search. RAG-F1 drop is annoying but maybe fixable via reranker or prompt tweaks.

lee: what's the unit-econ implication for GTN? product wants a per-request ceiling and a forecasted spend delta.

carmen: with current traffic profile (mix: 65% RAG, 25% chat, 10% embeddings) blended cost/request goes from $0.0111 -> $0.0062 (~44% savings). For 100k monthly active users, expected monthly token spend drops ~$27k -> $15k.

ash: acceptable if quality stays within product guardrails. What are edge regressions?

carmen: two notable: 1) hallucination rate in long RAG hops (>3 docs) increases slightly (esp. on numeric reasoning). 2) cold-context p95 spike for KV misses (we traced to slower dequant kernel path on first token).

mike: any mitigations tested?

carmen: tried three quick mitigations:
- reranker-as-filter: keep int4 generate but rerank top-10 with 13B-fp16 for queries flagged by short-answer classifier; small cost bump.
- dynamic cold-warm routing: warm contexts on int4, cold contexts route to baseline for first 2 tokens, then back to int4.
- prompt bias + safety-tempering: light prompt reweight to reduce hallucinations.

lee: cost math for reranker-as-filter?

carmen: eval classifier flags ~9% of traffic. Blended cost per request = 0.91*0.0069 + 0.09*(0.0069+0.0132) = $0.00786 (~29% savings vs full baseline).

ash: that keeps us well under the product microbudget of $0.0095/request that was discussed in GTN chat last quarter. Add that to proposal.

mike: ops: dynamic cold-warm routing is messy but doable: need stateful prefix cache TTL tuning and a fast-path for first-token dequant. Any infra blockers?

carmen: infra note: int4 runtime requires new kernel shipped in infer-runtime 2.8.0 (already in canary). Memory footprint is smaller but the host-side dequant pad increases cold latency. No new HW required.

reliability-bot: canary image built (infer-odin11b-int4:2026-11-11-rc2). Canary config saved at /deploy/canary/3301234567-odin11b.json

lee: product asks for explicit rollout + rollback thresholds. Draft something concise?

carmen: proposed rollout:
- Phase 0 (internal lab): A/B synthetic slice, 48h stability.
- Phase 1 (canary 1%): route only non-sensitive RAG traffic; enable reranker-as-filter for flagged queries. Monitor RAG-F1, hallucination rate, p95.
- Phase 2 (ramp 1->25% over 7 days): step increases with daily quality check-ins.
- Phase 3 (30-100%): gradual if metrics stable for 72h at 25% step.

Rollback triggers (auto):
- RAG-F1 drop >2.5 absolute pts on primary slice for 30m
- Hallucination rate >0.5% absolute increase for 1h
- p95 > 520ms sustained for 45m
- Blended spend per-unique-user increases >10% vs baseline cohort

lee: add a manual stop: product can pause rollout immediately if critical UX regression reported.

mike: monitoring checklist: dashboards for per-slice F1, hallucination alerts, classifier FN rate, blended cost per request, and cold-warm kernel latency. Also add a canary kill switch and reranker budget cap.

ash: CI microtests to gate merges:
- smoke-rag-f1: ensure RAG-F1 delta <3.0 pts over last 24h sample
- embed-sanity: embed-cos decline <0.02 absolute
- tail-latency: p95 cold <520ms on nightly run
- reranker-flip: ensure reranker path doesn't exceed 15% additional budget in simulated traffic

carmen: S3 slice + README uploaded: https://s3.redwood/slices/3301-odin11b-onboard. README includes bench CSV, classifier model, and reranker config.

lee: product ok to pilot at 1% with reranker-as-filter. Please include a short PRD blurb for GTN summarizing tradeoffs and savings.

carmen: will draft PRD blurb and attach to the canary config. Starting canary tomorrow 07:00 PT unless anyone objects. :rocket:

mike: please @me when dashboards are live.

ash: thumbs up from me. Keep the rollback windows tight for the ramp.

carmen: thanks all — will post updates in this thread as canary progresses.

reliability-bot: deploy scheduled for 2026-11-12T07:00:00-08:00 (canary).
